By this point in the build, 11 other Boost libraries have built DLLs, however ...

    ...\buildtrees> findstr /m /s vc140 *.log
    boost-thread\build-x86-windows-rel-out.log

... none of them mention anything about vc140 in their build log. The weird `/boost//(absolute path)` above also appears only in -thread's log.

VS2019 16.0.4 installed, existing installation of VS2017 renamed at the "2017" directory because otherwise the build uses that regardless of `set(VCPKG_PLATFORM_TOOLSET v142)`, environment variables, etc.
